hypothesis.statement: The COP path length has good single-trial test-retest reliability across 3 repeated eyes-open-firm quiet-standing trials in the BDS cohort (ICC(2,1) > 0.75), and the 3-trial average is more reliable still; the newly-authored intraclassCorrelation reproduces psych::ICC(lmer=FALSE) and pingouin.intraclass_corr to machine precision.

analysis_plan.dataset: Santos & Duarte (2016) BDS; COP path length (PhysioMoCap::swayMetrics) across 3 repeated eyes-open-firm quiet-standing trials, 163 subjects

decision.threshold: descriptive: intraclassCorrelation equals pingouin.intraclass_corr and psych::ICC(lmer=FALSE) to machine precision (|diff| < 1e-9); the single-trial ICC(2,1) exceeds 0.75 (good reliability) and the 3-trial-average ICC(2,k) exceeds 0.9
